failure_mechanism: V5 boundary=True in live log monitor scans mutable output/cache and writes the disk log while unchanged worker boundaries can scan the same charged scopes. Exception handler consumes a worker wait but rethrows before writing actual_wait.json.
live_scope_policy: No boundary=True or charged-scope disk log writes after Popen until actual direct wait and owned group ESRCH. Live guard checks use boundary=False and preserve exact source/policy/reservation validation. Scratch observation is single-pass and race-tolerant, not a stable measurement or OS quota.
original_observation_basis: Root reports supervisor tool28505 exit1 at boundary scan while worker2545954 wrote; worker absence reported by root. This source-only task did not query processes or infer the worker exit code from absence.
recovery: Fresh output plus fresh worker_aux and root reservation/admission. Reuse exact v5 successful short qualification, original observation inputs, scientific worker/config and unary policy. Old v5 scope remains fully preserved and charged until root separately certifies any closure.
resume_source_evidence: american_c3_common_v1.Writer requires a nonexistent output directory; prepare forbids overwrite/replay.
american_c3_observe_v3.execute always creates SampleData and runs infer/collapse/date; it exposes no load-partial/resume entry.
terminal_scope_policy: Original strict boundary and planned-growth checks before/after terminal log persistence, only after all owned group writers are absent.
unavoidable_limit: SIGKILL of the supervisor, host failure or an unwritable filesystem can prevent local receipt persistence. No fabricated worker exit or reconstructed actual wait is permitted; emitted root stdout is additional evidence.
wait_policy: Caught supervisor exceptions terminate only the new owned process group, wait the actual child and record its true return code, prove group ESRCH before boundary scans, and always emit compact OS-wait evidence. Primary/fallback receipt writes use the charged root packet metadata allowance without a live product scan.
